Alex / Samira — sorry for the friction and thanks for the screenshots. Quick notes and what we did:

- Fix applied: I regenerated the invite as a Zoom-only event and swapped the organizer to Marissa so the invite originates from the SE's account (we've seen external RSVP/permission blockers when invites come from reseller/test accounts).
